data.text: Noah, voice_station.py is now pushed: branch air-quality-stt @ 6f02ef9, apps/speech/voice_station.py (+ stt.py, needs the apps/speech venv: uv venv --python 3.12 apps/speech/.venv && uv pip install -r apps/speech/requirements.txt atech pyserial; ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in .env). Run: apps/speech/.venv/bin/python apps/speech/voice_station.py --port /dev/cu.usbmodem101 --api http://127.0.0.1:3001. It must be the ONLY process on the board's USB, so stop /tmp/foundershub-overnight-usb-test.py first. Tested on Anders' Mac against main 0740237: button → Mac mic → ElevenLabs → board screen and speaker; telemetry to /api/telemetry; claims and acks /api/devices/kitchen/actions. It posts orders as speech_transcript to /api/device-events. On main the reply is "Connect your Oda account" unless Oda is connected.
